long_biography.plain_text:
Harrison entered luxury watch distribution in 1990, working for a small British public company before founding Redgrave Luxury in 2006. He then formed a joint venture with Richard Mille for the watchmaker's distribution across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. This model aligned his company's economics with the brand's growth instead of relying on short-term agency contracts.

That structure made Harrison both regional chief executive and an equity-linked operating partner. He favoured tightly controlled distribution and reinvested margins in monobrand boutiques. Sport, art and cultural partnerships gave the brand a coherent identity across varied markets. Competitive sailing became part of that strategy and his own public life. After years of campaigning high-performance boats, he won the Admiral's Cup and continues to helm a professional racing team.
